name: riikkak.github.io
description: Personal blog and school course sites
author: Riikka Koskenranta

scripts.build:css: npm run build:css:blog && npm run build:css:english && npm run build:css:swedish
scripts.build:css:blog: lessc less/blog/main.less themes/blog/css/styles.css && cleancss -o themes/blog/css/styles.min.css themes/blog/css/styles.css
scripts.build:css:english: lessc less/english/main.less themes/english/css/styles.css && cleancss -o themes/english/css/styles.min.css themes/english/css/styles.css
scripts.build:css:swedish: lessc less/swedish/main.less themes/swedish/css/styles.css && cleancss -o themes/swedish/css/styles.min.css themes/swedish/css/styles.css
